description: Hash-bound terrain acceptance (Phase 4 A6) used by validation/terrain_gate.py. A final V-09, V-10, V-11 or V-12 run needs every pair of overlapping registered non-synthetic DEM products to be accepted here, each product identified by its registry key, the SHA-256 of its DEM and the SHA-256 of its error map. Re-registering any listed file with other bytes ends that acceptance. The digest of this file is recorded in every validation run and checked when results are merged.
